input.subject: Stripe — Backend Engineer Role | Next Steps
input.message_body:
Hi Saad,

Thanks for taking the time to chat last Thursday. The team enjoyed your discussion of the LaminARCH credit system and the atomic RPC approach.

We'd like to move forward with a technical interview. Here are the next steps:

1. 60-min systems design round with Priya (Staff Engineer) — Tuesday or Wednesday next week
2. 45-min coding round on CoderPad
3. Founder chat with a member of our leadership team

The job description is attached, and you can also find it on our careers page: https://stripe.com/jobs/listing/backend-engineer

Let me know what times work for you and I'll send calendar invites.

Best,
Anna Chen
Technical Recruiter, Stripe
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/anna-chen-stripe
